studies.officialTitle: A Phase I, Blinded Within Dose Groups, Multiple Dose, Placebo-controlled Study to Assess the Safety, Tolerability, Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of Different Titration Schemes of BI 456906 in Patients With Obesity and Overweight.

design.description: Two-part multiple-rising-dose study evaluating seven dose-escalation schedules and placebo.

studies.population: Adults aged 18 to under 70 years with BMI from 27 to under 40 kg/m2, stable body weight and HbA1c below 6.5%.
studies.overallDuration: Part A 6 weeks; Part B 16 weeks
studies.safetySummary: The peer-reviewed report described gastrointestinal disorders as the main adverse events leading to treatment discontinuation in the longer Part B; the published dose-schedule result could not be mapped completely without the detailed schedule table.

sources.title: Phase I studies of the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics of the dual glucagon receptor/glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist BI 456906

studies.officialTitle: A Phase II, Randomized, Double Blind, Parallel Group,46 Weeks Dose-finding Study of BI 456906 Administered Once Weekly Subcutaneously Compared With Placebo in Patients With Obesity or Overweight

design.description: Five-arm dose-finding trial with a 20-week flexible dose-escalation period followed by 26 weeks of maintenance treatment.

studies.population: Adults with BMI at least 27 kg/m2, without diabetes, after at least one unsuccessful nonsurgical weight-loss attempt.
studies.safetySummary: Gastrointestinal adverse events were the most frequent treatment-emergent adverse events; the peer-reviewed report described the overall tolerability profile as similar to GLP-1 receptor mono-agonists.

sources.title: Glucagon and GLP-1 receptor dual agonist survodutide for obesity: a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, dose-finding phase 2 trial

studies.officialTitle: Open-label, Randomised, 4 Parallel-group, Phase I Clinical Trial to Investigate BI 456906 Occupancy of Glucagon Receptors in Liver and Glucagon-like Peptide 1 Receptors in Pancreas in Comparison With Semaglutide After Administration of Radiolabeled Tracer in Male and Female Subjects With Obesity Using PET and MRI

design.description: Four-arm PET/MRI receptor-occupancy study crossing two treatments with liver or pancreas imaging cohorts.

studies.population: Adults with obesity, BMI 30 to 40 kg/m2, without type 1 or type 2 diabetes.

studies.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Randomised, Double-blind, Parallel-group, 76-week, Efficacy and Safety Study of BI 456906 Administered Subcutaneously Compared With Placebo in Participants With Overweight or Obesity Without Type 2 Diabetes

design.description: Three-arm trial of dose-adjusted once-weekly survodutide or placebo with lifestyle modification.

studies.population: Adults with BMI at least 30 kg/m2, or at least 27 kg/m2 with an obesity-related complication, without type 2 diabetes.
studies.safetySummary: Gastrointestinal symptoms were the most common adverse events and were typically mild to moderate; no deaths were reported in the peer-reviewed primary report.

sources.title: Survodutide Once Weekly for the Treatment of Adults with Obesity

studies.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Randomised, Double-blind, Parallel-group, 76-week, Efficacy and Safety Study of BI 456906 Administered Subcutaneously Compared With Placebo in Participants With Overweight or Obesity and Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

design.description: Three-arm trial of dose-adjusted once-weekly survodutide or placebo with lifestyle modification.

studies.population: Adults with BMI at least 27 kg/m2 and type 2 diabetes, with a prior unsuccessful dietary weight-loss effort.

sources.title: Baseline characteristics in the SYNCHRONIZE-2 randomized phase 3 trial

studies.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Randomised, Double-blind, Parallel-group, Event-driven, Cardiovascular Safety Study With BI 456906 Administered Subcutaneously Compared With Placebo in Participants With Overweight or Obesity With Established Cardiovascular Disease (CVD) or Chronic Kidney Disease, and/or at Least Two Weight-related Complications or Risk Factors for CVD

design.description: Event-driven cardiovascular safety trial with two survodutide dose groups and placebo.

studies.population: Adults with overweight or obesity and established cardiovascular disease or chronic kidney disease, and/or at least two weight-related complications or cardiovascular risk factors; type 2 diabetes was permitted.
studies.overallDuration: Event-driven; follow-up up to approximately 114 weeks

studies.officialTitle: A Phase III, Randomised, Double-blind, Parallel-group, 76-week, Efficacy and Safety Study of Survodutide Administered Subcutaneously Compared With Placebo in Patients With Obesity Disease in Japanese

design.description: Three-arm Japanese obesity-disease trial of once-weekly survodutide or placebo.

studies.population: Japanese adults with obesity disease and required obesity-related comorbidities; eligible participants could have or not have type 2 diabetes.

sources.title: Survodutide for the Treatment of Obesity Disease in Japanese Participants: Rationale, Design and Baseline Characteristics of the Phase 3 SYNCHRONIZE-JP Trial

studies.officialTitle: A Double-blind, Randomized, Placebo-controlled, Multiple-dose, Parallel Group With Nested Crossover Design Trial With Moxifloxacin as Positive Control to Evaluate the Effects of Multiple Subcutaneous Doses of BI 456906 in a Titration Scheme on Cardiac Safety Parameters in (Otherwise) Healthy Male and Female Subjects With Overweight/Obesity

design.description: Three parallel treatment sequences with a nested crossover evaluation of cardiac repolarization.

studies.population: Otherwise healthy adults with BMI 27.0 to 39.9 kg/m2 and body weight above 70 kg.

studies.officialTitle: A Phase III, Randomized, Double-blind, Parallel-group, Efficacy and Safety Study of BI 456906 Administered Subcutaneously Compared With Placebo in Chinese Participants With a BMI >=28 kg/m2 or BMI >=24 kg/m2 With at Least One Weight-related Complication

design.description: Three-arm Chinese efficacy and safety trial of once-weekly survodutide or placebo.

studies.population: Chinese adults with BMI at least 28 kg/m2, or at least 24 kg/m2 with a weight-related complication; participants with or without type 2 diabetes were eligible.
studies.overallDuration: Primary assessment at Week 52; approximately 76 weeks overall

studies.officialTitle: Multicentre, Randomised, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled, 48-week, Phase III Trial to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of Survodutide Administered Subcutaneously in Participants With Overweight or Obesity and Presumed or Confirmed Nonalcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH)

design.description: Two-to-one randomization to once-weekly survodutide or placebo, with 24 weeks of dose escalation and 24 weeks of maintenance.

studies.population: Adults with obesity, or overweight with an obesity complication, and at-risk MASLD defined by liver steatosis plus evidence of inflammation or fibrosis; type 2 diabetes was permitted.
studies.safetySummary: Gastrointestinal adverse events were most frequent, usually occurred during dose escalation and were generally mild to moderate; treatment discontinuation occurred in 19.9% with survodutide and 4.3% with placebo.

sources.title: Survodutide in adults with obesity and metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease: SYNCHRONIZE-MASLD

design.description: Two-arm mechanistic study assessing energy expenditure and fatty-acid oxidation after clinically meaningful weight loss.

studies.population: Adults with obesity, BMI 30 to 45 kg/m2, without type 1 or type 2 diabetes.
studies.overallDuration: Until at least 10% weight loss or up to 36 weeks
